lines.t: In the quiet of the morning, my soul finds rest,
You whisper peace through valleys I've been blessed.
Still waters calm the storms inside my chest,
Your hand restores my heart, my fear’s at rest.
The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want,
Through shadowed paths, Your light still shines.
Goodness and mercy chase where I roam,
Forever You lead me, forever I’m home.
You guide my steps through wilderness unknown,
Your rod and staff, they make me strong.
When darkness falls, I’m not alone,
Your love’s my shelter, my victory song.
The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want,
Through shadowed paths, Your light still shines.
Goodness and mercy chase where I roam,
Forever You lead me, forever I’m home.
You prepare a table, my soul’s delight,
Even before my enemies’ sight.
My cup overflows with endless grace,
Your presence forever fills this place.
The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want,
Through every trial, Your truth will shine.
Goodness and mercy will guide me home,
Forever I’ll dwell where love’s throne shone.
And when I walk that golden shore,
Your voice will call, my heart will soar.
The Shepherd leads, I follow still—
Forever safe within His will.
